meta.title: A new stage can only be added from an RFP
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot enable is_add_new_stage_allowed; when it is OFF, the application returns code 1127 instead of code 2001.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (is_add_new_stage_allowed=ON) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the trade add new stage in live event request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “New stage cannot be added unless the referring stage is an RFP”, and never with a server error.
